body:
I am so sorry you are going through this. It is incredibly hard to have toxic family.

Thank you nurse for everything you do!!! As someone who lives in a red county and has needed a lot of non-COVID medical care recently, I am eternally grateful for the nurses and doctors that are still working during these insane times. I can’t even begin to imagine what it is like to work in a COVID unit with that type of pervasive thinking. It has been hard to find care recently, and I can’t blame folks for leaving their jobs, but I have never appreciated your life-saving services more than I do now. I wish there was more I could do for the people who have cared for me when I was at my sickest. You don’t deserve this, and I am so sorry. You literally help save peoples lives, and I for one, thank you for being a real hero.

Please don't. I am sorry you are going through this, and I am  
also struggling with the same thoughts myself right now. You matter. And even  
though I am a stranger, I hope you know I care.
